name.ja: <ruby>海晶乙女<rt>マリンセス</rt></ruby>ウルピス

text.en: If this card is in your hand: You can discard 1 other "Marincess" card or WATER monster; Special Summon this card. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Set 1 "Marincess" Spell/Trap from your Deck. You can send 1 "Marincess" Link Monster Card you control to the GY; draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Marincess Ulpis" once per turn.
